content:
emily: quick report: onboarding sampleapp created duplicate invoices. Repro: createInvoice -> 429 -> client retries with tiny jitter (~30ms) -> token auto-refresh completes mid-retry -> server accepts duplicate.

emily: important log snippet:
```
2026-04-02T10:11:05Z WARN 429 req=inv-9 backoff=32ms
2026-04-02T10:11:05Z INFO auth refresh for user=9
2026-04-02T10:11:05Z INFO retry req=inv-9 headers=(authorization: Bearer new) // x-rw-replay-id MISSING
2026-04-02T10:11:05Z INFO server created invoice id=inv-334 duplicate=true
```

rahul: sounds like replay-id lost during auth refresh or retry clone. Are we generating the replay id before auth.ensureValid()?

jin: checked Node SDK v0.9.2: replay id generation moved into transport meta recently. retry clone does a shallow copy and meta->headers wasn't merged. So clone lost replay header.

emily: short-term mitigation: bump sampleapp min 429 backoff to 200ms to avoid common refresh window. Long-term: patch SDK to attach x-rw-replay-id at API boundary and carry in request context through refresh.

rahul: agreed. propose spec: header name x-rw-replay-id (uuidv4), semantics per-logical-request, immutable across retries; optional x-rw-replay-seq for multipart streams. Add test harness that simulates token rotate mid-retry and asserts no duplicate side-effects.

jin: PR incoming with: (1) generate replay id at API entry and set header, (2) ensure retry clone merges meta->headers, (3) unit+integration test that fakes refresh mid-retry.

ci-bot: created ticket DEVEX-5230: replay-id-clone-parity -> assigned devex + eng-platform

ops-bot: temporary config: sampleapp 429 min-backoff set to 200ms until SDKs patched

emily: i'll attach repro harness and logs to the PR. please review quickly, this hits new hires during evals. :thumbsup:
